data.statement: The persisted 'Play completion beep' setting is dead functionality: play_completion_beep is written by the Settings page and validated by settings_service, but no controller or completion path reads it, so the operator hears nothing. Wire it to the shared threaded operation runner terminal outcomes.

acceptance: completion_beep_enabled_from_settings returns False for a non-mapping payload, False for a missing key, and mirrors the persisted boolean otherwise.
misc_ui_controller.play_completion_beep calls QApplication.beep() exactly once when the active settings payload enables the beep.
misc_ui_controller.play_completion_beep does not call QApplication.beep() when the setting is absent, disabled, or the window exposes no settings payload.
A successful threaded operation emits one completion beep when the setting is enabled and none when it is disabled.
A failed threaded operation emits one completion beep when the setting is enabled.
A cancelled threaded operation emits no completion beep.
data.reason: User delegated the choice between wiring and removal; wiring is chosen because the setting already has UI, validation, persistence and shipped example config, so removal would destroy operator-visible functionality that only lacks its final consumer. The change is additive, confined to UI-layer code, fully unit-testable with a monkeypatched beep, and trivially reversible.
scope: IN: ui_state_service predicate; misc_ui_controller beep emitter; operation_runner_controller success/failure wiring; their unit tests; Operation_Orchestration and Platform_Settings_UI component docs. OUT: removing the setting; new UI strings; per-page ad-hoc completion paths that do not use the shared runner; any change to settings persistence or validation.
data.source: User chat (RO): bug 4 - 'Play completion beep' e functionalitate moarta; actiune: ori cablare la finalul operatiei (QApplication.beep()), ori scoatere a setarii.
data.understanding: play_completion_beep is persisted end-to-end (settings.example.json, settings_service defaults/validation, settings_page load/build) but never consumed at runtime, so the checkbox is inert. Fix by consuming it at the single shared completion point: ui_state_service gains a pure predicate completion_beep_enabled_from_settings(settings_payload) mirroring current_language_from_settings; misc_ui_controller gains play_completion_beep(window) which reads window._settings_payload through that predicate and calls QApplication.beep() only when enabled; operation_runner_controller calls it from _handle_operation_success and _handle_operation_failure. Cancellation stays silent because the operator triggered it and is already at the machine.

data.summary: New completion-beep checks fail before implementation: 6 failed, 4 passed. ui_state_service has no completion_beep_enabled_from_settings and misc_ui_controller has no play_completion_beep, so the runner has nothing to call.

Repointed the runner beep double from misc_ui_controller.play_completion_beep to QApplication.beep. The original double recorded the runner's request, so the disabled-preference check measured a boundary that is silent by construction; patching the audible call makes all three runner checks verify the end-to-end outcome.

data.rationale: Operators start long TTS, AI, and assembly runs and leave the machine; the persisted 'Play completion beep' preference exists in the Settings UI and in shipped configuration but had no runtime consumer, so the operator received no audible signal when work ended.
data.requirement: The application shall play one audible completion beep when a threaded workflow operation reaches a success or failure outcome while the persisted completion-beep setting is enabled.
data.verification: Automated: pytest selectors patching QApplication.beep verify the resolver, the emitter, and one beep on each of the success and failure runner outcomes.

data.rationale: A beep the operator did not ask for is noise, and cancellation is operator-initiated so the operator is already present; the silent paths are as much a contract as the audible one.
data.requirement: The application shall stay silent at operation completion when the completion-beep setting is disabled or absent, and when the operator cancelled the operation.
data.verification: Automated: pytest selectors patching QApplication.beep assert no audible call for the disabled, absent, and operator-cancelled paths.
